questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q1】A 40-year-old man has a positive stool guaiac test during a routine physical examination. A colonoscopy is performed and a 0.9-cm, circumscribed, pedunculated mass on a short stalk is found in the upper rectum. Which of the following terms best describes this lesion?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q1 原題｜王約翰教授 111、113、114 年連考必考題（PBD9 266–268 / BP9 162–163）】**：大腸直腸黏膜腺體起源的良性上皮腫瘤稱為**腺瘤（Adenoma）**，巨觀典型表現為體積小、界線清楚、具短蒂的息肉狀腫塊（circumscribed, pedunculated mass on a short stalk）。
**(A) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Adenoma` —— 腺瘤為源自腺體上皮的良性腫瘤，常呈界線清楚的有蒂息肉，表面摩擦出血可致糞便潛血（stool guaiac test）陽性。
**(B) 錯誤**：`Carcinoma` —— 癌為上皮來源惡性腫瘤，多呈大型不規則無蒂腫塊、生長快速且伴隨表面潰瘍與浸潤。
**(C) 錯誤**：`Choristoma` —— 迷離瘤（異位組織塊）為正常組織出現在異常解剖部位（如胃壁內的異位胰臟組織）。
**(D) 錯誤**：`Hamartoma` —— 錯構瘤為原發部位成熟組織呈混亂比例的過度生長（如 Peutz-Jeghers 息肉或肺錯構瘤）。
**(E) 錯誤**：`Hyperplasia` —— 增生為多株性反應性細胞數目增加，通常不形成界線分明之單一腫瘤性有蒂腫塊。
**(F) 錯誤**：`Sarcoma` —— 肉瘤為間葉組織（mesenchyme）起源的惡性腫瘤。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q1) Official Explanation｜PBD9 266–268｜BP9 162–163】**：`1 A: An adenoma is a benign epithelial neoplasm (arising in the glands of the colonic mucosa in this case). Small, circumscribed, pedunculated lesions are usually benign. Because it is turnorous and circumscribed, this lesion is not diagnostic of a hyperplastic process. Both carcinomas (arising from epithelium) and sarcomas (arising from mesenchyme) are malignant and tend to be large, irregular masses with rapid growth and ulceration. A choristoma is an ectopic cluster of normal tissue (e.g., pancreatic tissue in the stomach wall). A hamartoma is a tumor-like reactive or congenital clustering of tissues organized in a caricature of normal regional anatomy.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q2｜111、112、113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q2】A 32-year-old woman has experienced dull pelvic pain for the past 2 months. Physical examination shows a right adnexal mass. An abdominal ultrasound scan shows a 7.5-cm cystic ovarian mass. The mass is surgically excised. The surface of the mass is smooth, and it is not adherent to surrounding pelvic structures. On gross examination, the cystic mass is filled with hair. Microscopically, squamous epithelium, tall columnar glandular epithelium, cartilage, and fibrous connective tissue are present and resemble normal tissue counterparts. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q2 原題｜王約翰教授 111、112、113、114 年四年全勤必考題（PBD9 267–268 / BP9 163–164）】**：源自全能生殖細胞（totipotential germ cell）、同時包含外胚層（毛髮、鱗狀上皮）、內胚層（高柱狀腺上皮）與中胚層（軟骨、纖維結締組織）三胚層成熟組織的卵巢囊腫，為**成熟囊性畸胎瘤（Mature cystic teratoma / Dermoid cyst）**。（註：王約翰教授考卷將選項精簡為 4 個時，Teratoma 位於選項 B）。
**(G) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Teratoma` —— 畸胎瘤由兩個以上胚層分化而成，最常發生於育齡女性卵巢，良性者表面光滑不沾黏，囊內常充滿毛髮與皮脂。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(D)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：`Adenocarcinoma`（惡性腺癌）、`Fibroadenoma`（乳房常見良性纖維腺瘤）、`Glioma`（中樞神經膠質瘤）、`Hamartoma`（局部原有組織錯構瘤，卵巢原本無毛髮與軟骨，故非錯構瘤）、`Mesothelioma`（惡性間皮瘤）、`Rhabdomyosarcoma`（惡性橫紋肌肉瘤）皆不含跨三胚層分化。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q2) Official Explanation｜PBD9 267–268｜BP9 163–164】**：`2 G: A teratoma contains elements derived from more than one germ cell layer (ectoderm, endoderm, mesoderm), because the cell of origin is totipotential. Such cross-differentiation typically occurs in gonadal locations where germ cells reside, most commonly in the ovary of a reproductive-age woman, and these neoplasms are typically benign cystic lesions (dermoid cysts). Note: In Prof. Wang's 4-option exam version, Teratoma is option (B).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q3】A 62-year-old man has had several episodes of hematuria in the past week. He has a 48 pack-year history of smoking cigarettes. On physical examination, there are no abnormal findings. A urinalysis shows 4+ hematuria, and cytologic examination of the urine shows that atypical cells are present. A cystoscopy is performed and a 4-cm sessile mass with a nodular, ulcerated surface is seen in the dome of the bladder. Which of the following terms best describes this lesion?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q3 原題｜王約翰教授 113、114 年必考題（PBD9 269–271 / BP9 163–164, 199）】**：老菸槍（48 pack-year，吸菸為泌尿上皮癌頭號危險因子）出現無痛性血尿（4+ hematuria）、尿液細胞學見異型細胞，膀胱鏡見 4 公分**無蒂（sessile）、結節狀且表面潰瘍（nodular, ulcerated surface）**腫塊，為典型**泌尿上皮癌（Urothelial carcinoma）**。
**(B) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Carcinoma` —— 源自膀胱泌尿上皮的惡性腫瘤稱為癌（carcinoma），無蒂寬基底伴隨潰瘍及異型細胞均為惡性特徵。
**(A)/(C)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：`Adenoma` 為良性腺瘤；`Fibroma` 為良性纖維瘤；`Papilloma` 為良性乳突瘤（體積小、有蒂且呈纖細乳突分枝，無潰瘍）；`Sarcoma` 為罕見間葉惡性肉瘤。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q3) Official Explanation｜PBD9 269–271｜BP9 163–164, 199】**：`3 B: This clinical and gross appearance is typical of a malignant tumor arising in the urothelium—a urothelial carcinoma. Note the link to cigarette smoking. An adenoma is a benign tumor arising in glandular epithelium. A fibroma is a benign tumor of mesenchymal origin. A papilloma is a benign tumor of squamous or urothelial origin that typically is small and pedunculated with delicately branching fronds. A sarcoma is a malignant mesenchymal lesion, uncommon in the bladder.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q5】A 50-year-old woman undergoes screening colonoscopy as part of a routine health maintenance work-up. An isolated 1-cm pedunculated polyp is found in the sigmoid colon. The excised polyp histologically shows well-differentiated glands with no invasion of the stalk. Which of the following investigational research procedures can distinguish most clearly whether the polyp represents hyperplasia of the colonic mucosa or a tubular adenoma?

options.A: Flow cytometry to quantitate cells in the S phase

explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q5 原題｜王約翰教授 111、112、113、114 年四年全勤必考題（PBD9 268, 271 / BP9 162, 164）】**：區分**腫瘤（neoplasm，如管狀腺瘤 tubular adenoma）**與**反應性增生（hyperplasia）**最根本的分子生物學依據為**單株性（Monoclonality）**：所有真性腫瘤皆源自單一突變細胞的**單株增殖（monoclonal）**，而增生則為**多株增殖（polyclonal）**。
**(D) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Molecular marker of clonality` —— 透過單株性分子標記（如 X 染色體去活化分析或體細胞基因突變譜）證明單株起源，即可確診為管狀腺瘤而非黏膜增生。
**(A)/(B)/(C) 錯誤**：良性分化良好的腺瘤與黏膜增生在 S phase 比例、黏液（mucin）組織化學染色及角蛋白（keratin）免疫組化染色皆極為相似，無法有效區分單株腫瘤與多株增生。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q5) Official Explanation｜PBD9 268, 271｜BP9 162, 164】**：`5 D: Neoplasms are monoclonal proliferations of cells, whereas hyperplasias are polyclonal proliferations. Thus solving the problem rests on proving monoclonality. Both hyperplastic and benign neoplastic processes typically show normal numbers of cells in the S phase. Similarly, both lesions comprise well-differentiated cells from that region (both stain positively for mucin and keratin).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q11｜111、113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q11】A 69-year-old woman has experienced increasing malaise and a 10-kg weight loss over the past year. She dies of massive pulmonary thromboembolism. The gross appearance of the liver at autopsy is shown in the figure. Which of the following best describes the lesions seen in her liver?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q11 原題（附大R原書肝臟屍檢圖）｜王約翰教授 111、113、114 年必考題（PBD9 271–274 / BP9 168–169）】**：高齡病患體重減輕 10 公斤並死於大範圍肺血栓栓塞（副腫瘤高凝血狀態 Trousseau syndrome），附圖可見肝臟布滿**多發性、大小不一、中央臍凹（central umbilication，中心缺血壞死）的灰白色腫瘤結節**，為典型**肝臟轉移性腺癌（Metastatic adenocarcinoma）**。
**(D) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Metastatic adenocarcinoma` —— 肝臟接收門靜脈與肝動脈雙重血流，為大腸癌、胰臟癌、肺癌、乳癌最常見的轉移部位，巨觀呈現多發散在結節且常伴隨高凝血致死性肺栓塞。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(E) 錯誤**：`Invasive angiosarcoma` 多呈出血性海綿狀腫塊；`Hepatocellular carcinoma` 常伴肝硬化且多為單一主腫塊伴衛星結節；`Leukemic infiltration` 呈瀰漫性肝腫大而不形成大結節；`Multifocal hepatic adenomas` 為良性腫瘤，與惡病質及致死性肺栓塞不符。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q11) Official Explanation｜PBD9 271–274｜BP9 168–169】**：`11 D: Multiple, variably sized tan-white nodules scattered throughout the liver parenchyma with central umbilication (necrosis) are classic for metastatic carcinoma (most commonly adenocarcinoma from colon, pancreas, lung, or breast). Mucin-producing adenocarcinomas frequently induce a hypercoagulable paraneoplastic state (Trousseau syndrome), leading to fatal pulmonary thromboembolism.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q13｜113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q13】An epidemiologic study of cancer deaths recorded in the last half of the 20th century is conducted. The number of deaths for one particular type of cancer had been decreasing in developed nations, despite the absence of widespread screening and prevention programs. Which of the following neoplasms was most likely to be identified by this study?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q13 原題｜王約翰教授 113、114 年必考題（PBD9 275–277 / BP9 170）】**：20 世紀後半葉在已開發國家中，儘管**沒有普及的大規模篩檢計畫**，死亡率仍大幅自然下降的惡性腫瘤為**胃腺癌（Gastric adenocarcinoma）**，主因是冰箱冷藏普及、煙燻醃漬與亞硝酸鹽食物減少，以及幽門螺旋桿菌（*H. pylori*）感染率下降。
**(B) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Gastric adenocarcinoma` —— 胃癌死亡率在歐美已開發國家於過去半世紀下降逾 70%，為環境與飲食保存改善降低癌症發生率的經典範例。
**(A)/(C)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：腦膠質瘤（Cerebral glioma）、肝血管肉瘤（Hepatic angiosarcoma）、白血病（Leukemia）發生率並無此大幅下降趨勢；肺小細胞癌（Pulmonary small cell carcinoma）則在 20 世紀隨吸菸盛行而大幅上升。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q13) Official Explanation｜PBD9 275–277｜BP9 170】**：`13 B: Across developed nations during the last half of the 20th century, death rates for gastric adenocarcinoma fell dramatically even without mass screening programs, largely attributable to improved food refrigeration and decreased dietary intake of nitrites, smoked/salted foods, and reduced H. pylori transmission.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q15｜113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q15】An epidemiologic study analyzes health care benefits of cancer screening techniques applied to persons more than 50 years of age. Which of the following diagnostic screening techniques used in health care is most likely to have the greatest impact on reduction in cancer deaths in Europe and North America?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q15 原題｜王約翰教授 113、114 年必考題（PBD9 276–277 / BP9 170）】**：大R題庫官方解答（Answer 15: **B Mammography**）明確指出：針對歐美 **50 歲以上（>50 years of age）**族群，乳癌發生率高達 1/9 女性，透過**乳房攝影（Mammography）**早期偵測預後良好的小型乳癌，對降低該年齡層癌症死亡率的影響力最大！（註：1015 共筆曾誤植 C 並附註疑惑「B 是否更好」，經核對大R題庫原書詳解確認官方正解為 **B Mammography**）。
**(B) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Mammography` —— 篩檢計畫對死亡率的影響取決於該癌症在目標年齡層的高發生率與早期偵測效益；50 歲以上歐美族群乳癌盛行率極高，乳房攝影為最具降低死亡率效益的篩檢工具。
**(A)/(C)/(D)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：胸部 X 光（Chest radiograph）對早期肺癌敏感度低；子宮頸抹片（Pap smear）主要自年輕育齡女性即開始篩檢 CIN 原位病變；血清腫瘤標記、糞便潛血（stool guaiac）與尿液細胞學作為單一篩檢工具對總死亡率降幅較有限。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q15) Official Explanation｜PBD9 276–277｜BP9 170】**：`15 B: A screening program should reliably detect early cancers with higher incidence. Breast cancer affects up to 1 in 9 women in these regions. Mammography may aid in detection of small cancers that have a better prognosis. A chest radiograph is an insensitive technique for detecting early lung cancers. Because Pap smear screening can detect dysplasias and in situ carcinomas that can be treated before progression to invasive lesions, deaths from cervical carcinoma have steadily decreased since this screening method became widely available in the last half of the 20th century (primarily starting in younger reproductive-age women). Serum tumor markers, stool guaiac, and urine cytology have much lower sensitivity/impact as mass screening tools.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q16｜111、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q16】A 38-year-old woman has abdominal distention that has been worsening for the past 6 weeks. An abdominal CT scan shows bowel obstruction caused by a 6-cm mass in the jejunum. At laparotomy, a portion of the small bowel is resected. Flow cytometric analysis of a portion of the tumor shows a clonal population of B lymphocytes with high S phase. Translocation with activation of which of the following nuclear oncogenes is most likely to be present in this tumor?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q16 原題｜王約翰教授 111、114 年必考題（PBD9 284, 287–288 / BP9 175）】**：空腸腫塊由**高 S phase（極高增殖率）的單株 B 淋巴球**構成，為典型**伯基特氏淋巴瘤（Burkitt lymphoma）**，其特徵性染色體轉位 `t(8;14)` 會活化細胞核內轉錄因子致癌基因 **`MYC`（c-MYC）**。
**(C) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`MYC` —— `c-MYC` 為位於細胞核內的轉錄因子原致癌基因（nuclear oncogene），受 `t(8;14)` 轉位活化後會強力促進細胞進入 S phase 與有絲分裂。
**(A)/(B)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：`APC` 與 `p53` 為抑癌基因；`EGF` 為胞外生長因子；`RAS` 為位於細胞膜內側的 GTP 結合訊息傳遞蛋白（多由點突變活化而非核內轉錄因子轉位）。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q16) Official Explanation｜PBD9 284, 287–288｜BP9 175】**：`16 C: Burkitt lymphoma often presents as an abdominal/intestinal mass with a very high mitotic index (high S-phase fraction). It characteristically harbors a t(8;14) translocation that juxtaposes the c-MYC nuclear transcription factor proto-oncogene on chromosome 8 with the IgH locus on chromosome 14, driving constitutive MYC overexpression.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q17｜112、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q17】A 50-year-old woman has had easy fatigability and noted a dragging sensation in her abdomen for the past 5 months. Physical examination reveals that she is afebrile. She has marked splenomegaly, but no lymphadenopathy. Laboratory studies show her total WBC count is 250,000/mm3 with WBC differential count showing 64% segmented neutrophils, 11% band neutrophils, 7% metamyelocytes, 5% myelocytes, 4% myeloblasts, 3% lymphocytes, 2% basophils, 2% eosinophils, and 2% monocytes. A bone marrow biopsy is performed, and karyotypic analysis of the cells reveals a t(9;22) translocation. Medical treatment with a drug having which of the following modes of action is most likely to produce a complete remission in this patient?

options.C: Delivering normal p53 into cells with viral vectors
options.E: Preventing translocation of β-catenin to the nucleus

explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q17 原題｜王約翰教授 112、114 年必考題（PBD9 284–285 / BP9 175）】**：巨脾、白血球高達 250,000/mm³ 且骨髓核型出現費城染色體 **`t(9;22)` 轉位**，診斷為**慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）**。`t(9;22)` 產生 `BCR-ABL` 融合基因，編碼持續活化的**酪胺酸激酶（tyrosine kinase）**，使用標靶藥物 Imatinib（Gleevec）**抑制酪胺酸激酶活性（Inhibiting tyrosine kinase activity）**可達到完全緩解。
**(D) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Inhibiting tyrosine kinase activity` —— BCR-ABL 融合蛋白具持續活化的 tyrosine kinase 活性，標靶抑制該激酶為分子標靶治療的經典典範。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(E) 錯誤**：活化 caspases、抗 EGFR 抗體、病毒載體遞送 p53 或阻斷 β-catenin 入核皆非 CML `BCR-ABL` 的致病與標靶治療機轉。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q17) Official Explanation｜PBD9 284–285｜BP9 175】**：`17 D: This patient has chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) with the Philadelphia chromosome t(9;22), which creates the BCR-ABL fusion gene encoding a constitutively active tyrosine kinase. Targeted therapy with imatinib mesylate (Gleevec), a specific BCR-ABL tyrosine kinase inhibitor, achieves complete hematologic and cytogenetic remission in most patients.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q23｜112、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q23】A 70-year-old woman reported a 4-month history of a 4-kg weight loss and increasing generalized icterus. On physical examination, she has midepigastric tenderness on palpation. An abdominal CT scan shows a 5-cm mass in the head of the pancreas. Fine-needle aspiration of the mass is performed. On biochemical analysis, the neoplastic cells show continued activation of cytoplasmic kinases. Which of the following genes is most likely to be involved in this process?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q23 原題｜王約翰教授 112、114 年必考題（PBD9 281–282, 321–322 / BP9 177）】**：胰臟頭腫塊伴隨黃疸為典型**胰管腺癌（Pancreatic adenocarcinoma）**，超過 90% 具有 **`KRAS`（RAS 基因家族）點突變**。突變的 RAS 失去內生性 GTPase 水解能力，維持在持續活化的 GTP-bound 狀態，進而**持續活化細胞質內下游激酶（continued activation of cytoplasmic kinases，如 RAF/MAPK 與 PI3K 路徑）**。
**(D) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`RAS` —— `RAS` 為人類癌症最常發生點突變的原致癌基因（尤以胰臟癌、大腸癌、肺腺癌最常見），負責啟動胞質激酶訊息傳遞瀑布。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：`APC` 與 `p53` 為抑癌基因；`MYC` 為細胞核內轉錄因子；`RET` 為受體酪胺酸激酶（與 MEN2 相關）；`sis` 編碼 PDGF-β 生長因子。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q23) Official Explanation｜PBD9 281–282, 321–322｜BP9 177】**：`23 D: Point mutations in RAS family genes (especially KRAS, present in >90% of pancreatic adenocarcinomas) impair GTPase activity, trapping RAS in its active GTP-bound form and causing constitutive activation of downstream cytoplasmic kinases (RAF/MAPK and PI3K/AKT pathways).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q24｜112、113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q24】A 22-year-old man has a raised, pigmented lesion on his forearm that has increased in size and become more irregular in color over the past 4 months. Physical examination shows a 0.5 × 1.2 cm black-to-brown asymmetric lesion with irregular borders. An excisional biopsy specimen shows clusters of pleomorphic pigmented cells that extend into the reticular dermis. Family history indicates that the patient’s maternal uncle died from a similar tumor. His grandfather required enucleation of the left eye because of a “dark brown” retinal mass. Which of the following genes is most likely to have undergone mutation to produce these findings in this family?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q24 原題｜王約翰教授 112、113、114 年連考必考題（PBD9 284–287 / BP9 179–180）】**：年輕患者前臂出現不對稱、邊緣不規則且侵犯網狀真皮的色素性惡性腫瘤，且舅舅與外祖父皆有皮膚或眼內**黑色素瘤（Melanoma）**家族史，最常源於編碼細胞週期抑制蛋白 **`p16`（`INK4a` / `CDKN2A`）** 的抑癌基因生殖系突變。（註：王約翰教授 4 選項考卷中，`p16 (cell cycle inhibition)` 位於選項 C）。
**(E) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`p16 (cell cycle inhibition)` —— p16 為 CDK 抑制因子（CDKI），正常可抑制 Cyclin D/CDK4 磷酸化 RB；當 `p16` 突變失活時，細胞失去 G1/S 檢查點控制，易導致家族性黑色素瘤。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(D)/(F) 錯誤**：`BCL2`、`c-MYC`、`IL2`、`Lyn`、`p53`（Li-Fraumeni syndrome）皆非家族性黑色素瘤最典型的致病基因。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q24) Official Explanation｜PBD9 284–287｜BP9 179–180】**：`24 E: Inherited mutations in the CDKN2A gene encoding p16/INK4a (a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that blocks CDK4/6-cyclin D mediated phosphorylation of RB) are associated with familial malignant melanoma (as well as pancreatic carcinoma). Note: In Prof. Wang's 4-option exam version, p16 (cell cycle inhibition) is option (C).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q25｜112、113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q25】A 3-year-old child has exhibited difficulty with vision in her right eye. On physical examination, there is leukocoria of the right eye, consistent with a mass in the posterior chamber. MR imaging shows a mass that nearly fills the globe. The child undergoes enucleation of the right eye. Molecular analysis of the neoplastic cells indicates absence of both copies of a gene that contributes to control of the cell cycle. Which of the following genes has most likely undergone mutation in this neoplasm?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q25 原題｜王約翰教授 112、113、114 年連考必考題（PBD9 291, 293 / BP9 176, 182）】**：3 歲幼童右眼出現**白瞳症（leukocoria）**與眼內後房腫塊，為典型**視網膜母細胞瘤（Retinoblastoma）**，分子分析顯示控制細胞週期 G1/S 檢查點的 **`RB` 抑癌基因（位於 13q14）兩個拷貝皆缺失（Knudson 雙重打擊假說 two-hit hypothesis）**。（註：王約翰教授 4 選項考卷中，`RB` 位於選項 B）。
**(G) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`RB` —— RB 蛋白於低磷酸化狀態下會結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子，防止細胞跨越 G1/S 檢查點；雙對偶基因失活即引發視網膜母細胞瘤。
**(A)~(F) 錯誤**：`BCR-ABL`（CML）、`BCL2`（濾泡性淋巴瘤）、`hMSH2`（Lynch 症候群 DNA 錯配修復基因）、`K-RAS`、`NF1`、`p53` 皆非視網膜母細胞瘤的主導基因。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q25) Official Explanation｜PBD9 291, 293｜BP9 176, 182】**：`25 G: Retinoblastoma in early childhood presenting with leukocoria ('white pupil reflex') is the classic prototype of Knudson's two-hit hypothesis of tumor suppressor genes. Both copies (alleles) of the RB gene on chromosome 13q14 must be inactivated or deleted for retinoblastoma to develop. Note: In Prof. Wang's 4-option exam version, RB is option (B).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q31｜112、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q31】A 53-year-old man diagnosed with oral cancer and treated with radiation and chemotherapy 1 year ago now has a positron emission tomography (PET) scan of his neck that shows a single focus of increased uptake. This focus is resected and microscopic examination shows that it is a metastasis. Molecular analysis of this cancer shows p53, PTEN, and c-MYC gene mutations. Which of the following metabolic pathways is most likely up-regulated to promote his cancer cell survival and proliferation?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q31 原題｜王約翰教授 112、114 年必考題（PBD9 286, 298 / BP9 179）】**：正子斷層掃描（FDG-PET scan）能偵測轉移癌病灶，正是利用癌細胞即使在氧氣充足環境下仍大量攝取葡萄糖並偏好進行**有氧糖解作用（Aerobic glycolysis，即瓦氏效應 Warburg effect）**。`PTEN`、`p53` 與 `c-MYC` 突變會共同上調 GLUT1 與糖解酵素，提供快速分裂所需的碳骨架中間產物。
**(A) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Aerobic glycolysis` —— 瓦氏效應（Warburg effect）指腫瘤細胞在有氧下仍優先以糖解作用產生乳酸並累積生物合成中間物，是 PET 影像高顯影的生理基礎。
**(B)/(C)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：糖質新生（Gluconeogenesis）、五碳糖磷酸途徑、粒線體氧化磷酸化（Oxidative phosphorylation，在腫瘤中相對被下調）及嘌呤降解皆非 PET 高攝取與 Warburg effect 的主要上調途徑。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q31) Official Explanation｜PBD9 286, 298｜BP9 179】**：`31 A: Rapidly growing tumor cells shift their glucose metabolism away from mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation toward aerobic glycolysis (the Warburg effect), even in the presence of ample oxygen. This high hunger for glucose allows FDG-PET scanning to visualize metastases and supplies carbon intermediates needed for synthesizing lipids, nucleotides, and proteins during rapid cell division.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q37｜111、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q37】A 48-year-old woman notices a lump in her left breast. On physical examination she has a firm, nonmovable, 2-cm mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast. There are enlarged, firm, nontender lymph nodes in the left axilla. A fine-needle aspiration biopsy is performed, and the cells present are consistent with carcinoma. A lumpectomy with axillary lymph node dissection is performed, and carcinoma is present in two of eight axillary nodes. Reduced expression of which of the following molecules by the tumor cells is most likely responsible for the lymph node metastases?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q37 原題｜王約翰教授 111、114 年必考題（PBD9 305–306 / BP9 191–192）】**：惡性上皮腫瘤發生局部浸潤與轉移（Invasion-Metastasis Cascade）的第一步是**腫瘤細胞間黏附力喪失（loosening of intercellular junctions）**。負責維持上皮細胞間緊密黏附與接觸抑制的關鍵跨膜黏附分子為 **`E-cadherin`（上皮鈣黏蛋白）**，其表現量下降（reduced expression）會使癌細胞脫離原發灶並轉移至腋下淋巴結。
**(C) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`E-cadherin` —— E-cadherin 表現減少或基因突變（常見於乳腺浸潤性小葉癌與多種腺癌轉移過程）會解除上皮細胞間黏附，促進上皮間質轉化（EMT）與轉移。
**(A)/(B)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：`ERBB2 (HER-2)` 與 `Tyrosine kinases` 在癌細胞中通常為**過度表現（overexpression）**而非表現減少；ER/PR 荷爾蒙受體則與荷爾蒙治療反應相關，非掌管細胞黏附脫落的主因。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q37) Official Explanation｜PBD9 305–306｜BP9 191–192】**：`37 C: E-cadherin (epithelial cadherin) acts as an intercellular glue holding epithelial cells together and mediating contact inhibition via β-catenin. Loss or reduced expression of E-cadherin is a critical first step in the invasion-metastasis cascade (loosening of tumor cell-cell junctions), allowing carcinoma cells to detach from the primary mass and metastasize to regional lymph nodes.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q47｜111、112、113、114 學年度考古題原題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q47】A study of patients treated with chemotherapy protocols for cancer shows that 10% of them subsequently develop a second cancer, a much higher incidence compared with a control group not receiving chemotherapy. These chemotherapy protocols included the alkylating agent cyclophosphamide. What is the most likely mechanism by which this agent causes carcinogenesis in these treated cancer patients?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q47 原題｜王約翰教授 111、112、113、114 年四年全勤必考題（PBD9 322–324 / BP9 199–200）】**：化療烷化劑（alkylating agents，如 **Cyclophosphamide**）屬於**直接作用型化學致癌物（direct-acting carcinogens）**，不需經過肝臟 CYP450 代謝活化即可直接與 DNA 共價結合，造成**直接 DNA 損傷（Direct DNA damage）**與基因突變，導致約 10% 病患日後發生第二種繼發性惡性腫瘤（如繼發性白血病 AML 或膀胱癌）。
**(D) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Direct DNA damage` —— 烷化劑具高度親電子基團，可直接烷基化並交聯 DNA 鹼基，直接損傷 DNA 引發致癌突變。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：活化 PKC 為促癌劑（promoter，如佛波酯 TPA/PMA）機轉；烷化劑並非透過活化內源病毒、阻斷 TGF-β、抑制 DNA 修復酵素或抑制端粒酶致癌。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q47) Official Explanation｜PBD9 322–324｜BP9 199–200】**：`47 D: Alkylating agents such as cyclophosphamide are direct-acting chemical carcinogens that do not require metabolic conversion to become carcinogenic. Their electrophilic groups bind directly to DNA, causing direct DNA damage and mutations that predispose treated patients to secondary malignancies (especially acute myeloid leukemia and bladder cancer).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.1/Ch.7 Epigenetics】A study of peripheral blood smears shows that neutrophil nuclei of women have a Barr body, whereas those of men do not. The Barr body is an inactivated X chromosome. Which of the following forms of RNA is most likely to play a role in Barr body formation?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫原題｜王約翰教授 113 年考題（表觀遺傳與非編碼 RNA 調控）】**：女性細胞核內的巴氏小體（Barr body，去活化的 X 染色體）是由位於 X 染色體上的 `XIST` 基因轉錄出的**長鏈非編碼 RNA（Long noncoding RNA, `lncRNA`）**包裹整條 X 染色體，招募甲基轉移酶誘導異染色質化（基因靜默）所致。
**(A) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`lncRNA` —— 長鏈非編碼 RNA（>200 nucleotides，代表為 *XIST*）負責調節染色質重塑與 X 染色體去活化（Barr body 形成）。
**(B)/(C)/(D) 錯誤**：`mRNA` 負責轉譯蛋白質；`miRNA` 與 `siRNA` 為短鏈非編碼 RNA（約 21–23 nt），主要在轉錄後水平結合目標 mRNA 抑制轉譯或促使其降解。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.1/Ch.7 Epigenetics) Official Explanation｜PBD9 Ch.1 & Ch.7 Epigenetic Gene Silencing】**：`A (lncRNA): Long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs), specifically XIST (X-inactive specific transcript), coat the inactive X chromosome in females to promote repressive chromatin modifications (heterochromatin / Barr body formation) and gene silencing.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q4｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 4 題（附組織病理圖）
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q4】A 23-year-old woman has noted a nodule on the skin of her upper chest. She reports that the nodule has been present for many years and has not changed in size. It is excised, and the microscopic appearance is shown in the figure. Which of the following neoplasms is this lesion most likely to be?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q4（附原書組織切片圖）｜良性血管腫瘤命名與鑑別（PBD9 269–271 / BP9 163–164）】**：年輕女性前胸皮膚多年未變大的良性結節，顯微鏡下可見**密集排列、充滿紅血球且內襯單層扁平良性內皮細胞的血管腔室**，診斷為**血管瘤（Hemangioma）**。
**(B) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Hemangioma` —— 良性血管內皮腫瘤稱為血管瘤（hemangioma），切片下由充滿紅血球的分化良好微血管或海綿狀血管腔構成。
**(A)/(C)/(D)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：`Fibroadenoma` 為乳房纖維腺瘤；`Leiomyoma` 為平滑肌瘤；`Lipoma` 為成熟脂肪細胞構成之脂肪瘤；`Melanoma` 與 `Nevus` 為黑色素細胞腫瘤。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q4) Official Explanation｜PBD9 269–271｜BP9 163–164, 199】**：`4 B: The figure shows numerous variably sized vascular spaces filled with red blood cells and lined by flattened, uniform endothelial cells, typical of a benign hemangioma.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q6｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 6 題（附組織病理圖）
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q6】A 39-year-old woman underwent a routine health maintenance examination for the first time in many years. A Pap smear was obtained, and the result reported was abnormal. On pelvic examination, a red, slightly raised, 1-cm lesion on the anterior ectocervix at the 2 o’clock position was excised and biopsied. The microscopic appearance on medium-power magnification is shown in the figure. Which of the following is most characteristic of this patient’s condition?

options.B: Elevated CA-125 level in the serum
options.C: Positive HSV-2 molecular test in the lesion
options.D: Pulmonary nodules on a chest radiograph

explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q6（附原書組織切片圖）｜原位癌（Carcinoma in situ, CIS）核心特徵（PBD9 267–270, 334 / BP9 167）】**：附圖顯示子宮頸鱗狀上皮全層皆被異型不成熟細胞取代，但**基底膜（basement membrane）完整、尚未向下浸潤間質**，屬於**原位癌（Carcinoma in situ / HSIL）**。原位癌尚未接觸間質血管與淋巴管，不會轉移，因此**局部切除後治癒率達 100%（No recurrence following local excision）**。
**(E) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`No recurrence following local excision` —— 原位癌侷限於基底膜上方，局部完整切除即可完全治癒而不復發。
**(A)/(B)/(C)/(D) 錯誤**：此為子宮頸原發病變而非子宮內膜癌；CA-125 為卵巢癌標記；致病病毒為 **HPV（人類乳突病毒）** 而非 HSV-2；原位癌不會產生肺轉移結節。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q6) Official Explanation｜PBD9 267–270, 334｜BP9 167, 212–213】**：`6 E: The figure shows an in situ carcinoma of the squamous cervical epithelium with neoplastic growth only above the basement membrane. In situ cancers, limited to the epithelium, are noninvasive, and local excision has a 100% cure rate (no recurrence following local excision). This lesion is related to HPV, not HSV-2.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q7｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 7 題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q7】A 53-year-old woman has noticed increasing malaise. On physical examination, there are no abnormal findings, but a stool guaiac test is positive. Her hemoglobin level is 7.9 g/dL. A colonoscopy is performed, and a 3-cm sessile mass is found in the cecum. A biopsy specimen of the mass shows a moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma confined to the mucosa. An abdominal CT scan shows no lymphadenopathy or hepatic lesions. Given this information, which of the following is the best course of action?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q7｜盲腸大型無蒂腺癌之臨床處置（PBD9 268–270 / BP9 167）】**：右側大腸（盲腸 cecum）常以慢性潛血流失與缺鐵性貧血（Hb 7.9 g/dL）表現；3 公分大型無蒂（sessile）腺癌腫塊雖表淺切片僅見黏膜層侵犯，但因無蒂大型腫塊深部常有未取樣到的浸潤且無法僅靠內視鏡切除，標準處置為**外科手術切除（Right hemicolectomy 右側結腸切除術）**。
**(C) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Right hemicolectomy` —— 早期無遠端轉移之盲腸無蒂腺癌，根治性手術切除（含區域淋巴結廓清與病理分期）為首選治療。
**(A)/(B)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：無轉移之早期結腸癌首選為手術切除而非單純化療、放療或觀察等待。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q7) Official Explanation｜PBD9 268–270｜BP9 167】**：`7 C: A 3-cm sessile adenocarcinoma in the cecum—even when biopsy shows mucosal involvement—requires surgical resection (right hemicolectomy) because a large sessile mass cannot be safely removed piecemeal through the colonoscope and deeper invasion in unsampled areas must be ruled out.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q8】A 57-year-old woman has experienced an increasing feeling of fullness in her neck along with a 3-kg (7-lb) weight loss over the past 3 months. On physical examination, there is a firm, fixed mass in a 3 × 5 cm area in the right side of the neck. A CT scan shows a solid infiltrating mass in the region of the right lobe of the thyroid gland. A biopsy of the mass is performed and the microscopic appearance is shown in the figure. All areas of the tumor have similar morphology. Which of the following terms best describes this neoplasm?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q8（附原書組織切片圖）｜退行性分化／間變（Anaplasia）與不典型有絲分裂（PBD9 268–272 / BP9 165–167）】**：附圖中央可見極具代表性的**三極不典型有絲分裂像（bizarre tripolar mitotic figure，宛如賓士標誌）**、高度細胞核多形性（pleomorphism）、核深染與巨大腫瘤細胞，此種完全失去正常組織分化特徵的現象稱為**退行性分化／間變（Anaplastic）**。
**(A) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Anaplastic` —— 間變（anaplasia）意指「逆向分化／失去分化」，是高度惡性腫瘤（如甲狀腺未分化癌 anaplastic thyroid carcinoma）的組織學標誌，特徵包含多形性、高核質比（N:C ratio 接近 1:1）、腫瘤巨細胞及奇異多極有絲分裂。
**(B)/(C)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：`Apoptotic` 為細胞凋亡；`Dysplastic` 為異生（多指上皮內尚未突破基底膜的排列紊亂）；`Metaplastic` 為化生（一種成熟細胞被另一種成熟細胞取代）；`Well-differentiated` 為分化良好。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q8) Official Explanation｜PBD9 268–272｜BP9 165–167】**：`8 A: The figure reveals marked cellular and nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, tumor giant cells, and a bizarre tripolar mitotic figure—hallmarks of anaplasia (lack of differentiation), characteristic of anaplastic thyroid carcinoma.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q9｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 9 題（附組織病理圖）
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q9】A Pap smear obtained from a 29-year-old woman during a routine health maintenance examination is abnormal. She is currently asymptomatic. She has a history of multiple sexual partners. Cervical biopsy specimens are obtained and the microscopic appearance is shown in the figure. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q9（附原書組織切片圖）｜子宮頸原位癌（Carcinoma in situ / CIN III）（PBD9 269–271 / BP9 167）】**：附圖顯示左側尚可見部分含肝醣空泡的成熟表層鱗狀細胞，但整個上皮全層已被失去極性、核質比高且濃染的不成熟異生細胞取代，且**下方基底膜完整無間質侵犯**，診斷為**原位癌（Carcinoma in situ）**。
**(B) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Carcinoma in situ` —— 重度異生（severe dysplasia）波及上皮全層但尚未穿破基底膜時，即定義為原位癌（CIS）。
**(A)/(C)/(D)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：未見腺體惡性結構（非 Adenocarcinoma）；基底膜完整無間質浸潤（非 Invasive squamous cell carcinoma）；全層細胞具高度核異型性（非單純良性 Squamous metaplasia）。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q9) Official Explanation｜PBD9 269–271｜BP9 167】**：`9 B: The biopsy specimen shows full-thickness dysplastic replacement of the cervical squamous epithelium by immature basaloid cells with loss of normal maturation and polarity, but the underlying basement membrane remains intact without stromal invasion—diagnostic of carcinoma in situ (CIN III / HSIL).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q10】A 44-year-old woman notices a lump in her right breast while taking a shower. She has noted this mass for the past 2 months. She has no pain. On physical examination, there is a 3-cm, firm, irregular, nonmovable mass beneath the right areola, and a firm, nontender lymph node is palpable in the right axilla. Which of the following lesions is most likely to be present in her breast?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q10｜良惡性乳房腫塊與原位癌 vs. 浸潤癌鑑別（PBD9 271–272 / BP9 167–168）】**：乳房無痛、堅硬、邊緣不規則且**固定不可移動（nonmovable）**的腫塊，合併**同側腋下堅硬無痛淋巴結腫大（淋巴轉移）**，代表此腫瘤必定為**已突破基底膜的浸潤性癌（Infiltrating carcinoma，如選項中的 Infiltrating lobular carcinoma）**。
**(C) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Infiltrating lobular carcinoma` —— 唯有具局部浸潤（造成腫塊固定不移動）與淋巴管侵犯能力的浸潤性乳癌，才會導致腋下淋巴結轉移。
**(A)/(B)/(D)/(E) 錯誤**：`Acute mastitis` 會劇痛發紅發熱；`Fibroadenoma` 為界線清楚、具滑動性（movable）的良性腫瘤且不轉移；`Intraductal carcinoma (DCIS)` 為管內原位癌，未突破基底膜故**不會**發生腋下淋巴結轉移；`Leiomyosarcoma` 極少見且多經血行轉移而非淋巴轉移。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q10) Official Explanation｜PBD9 271–272｜BP9 167–168】**：`10 C: A firm, irregular, fixed (nonmovable) breast mass accompanied by firm, nontender ipsilateral axillary lymphadenopathy indicates an invasive malignancy that has crossed the basement membrane and metastasized via lymphatics—here, infiltrating lobular carcinoma. Intraductal carcinoma (DCIS) is in situ and does not metastasize to lymph nodes; fibroadenoma is well-circumscribed, movable, and benign.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q14｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 14 題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q14】An epidemiologic study of cancer deaths recorded in the last half of the 20th century is conducted. The number of deaths for one particular cancer had increased markedly in developed nations. More than 30% of cancer deaths in men, and more than 24% of cancer deaths in women, were caused by this neoplasm in 1998. In some nations, prevention strategies reduced deaths from this cancer. Which of the following neoplasms was most likely identified by this study?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q14｜癌症流行病學：頭號癌症死因（PBD9 275–277, 279 / BP9 170, 204）】**：20 世紀後半葉隨香菸普及而死亡率急遽攀升、並高居男女性**癌症死因第一位（佔男性癌症死亡 >30%、女性 >24%）**的惡性腫瘤為**支氣管肺癌（Bronchogenic carcinoma）**。
**(B) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Bronchogenic carcinoma` —— 肺癌為男女癌症死亡率榜首，且戒菸與菸害防制策略能有效降低其死亡率。
**(A)/(C)/(D)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：大腸癌、胰臟癌、黑色素瘤、肝癌與腦膠質瘤佔總癌症死亡比例皆遠低於支氣管肺癌。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q14) Official Explanation｜PBD9 275–277, 279｜BP9 170, 204】**：`14 B: Incidence of lung cancers (bronchogenic carcinoma) increased dramatically in the 20th century because of the popularity of cigarette smoking, accounting for the highest proportion of cancer deaths in both men (>30%) and women (>24%). Smoking cessation prevention programs have begun reducing lung cancer mortality.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q18｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 18 題（附組織病理圖）
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q18】A 54-year-old woman notes a lump in her right breast. Physical examination shows a 2-cm mass fixed to the underlying tissues beneath the areola and three firm, nontender, lymph nodes palpable in the right axilla. There is no family history of cancer. An excisional breast biopsy is performed, and microscopic examination shows the findings in the figure. Over the next 6 months, additional lymph nodes become enlarged, and CT scans show nodules in the lung, liver, and brain. Which of the following molecular abnormalities is most likely to be found in her carcinoma cells?

options.C: Fusion of EWS and FLI1 genes

explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q18（附原書組織切片圖）｜乳癌 `ERBB2 (HER-2)` 基因擴增與標靶治療（PBD9 284, 287 / BP9 174）】**：無家族史之偶發性浸潤性乳管癌（附圖見惡性腺管浸潤間質）在短時間內廣泛轉移至肺、肝與腦部，最常伴隨受體酪胺酸激酶原致癌基因 **`ERBB2 (HER-2/neu)` 的基因擴增（Gene amplification）**，臨床上可使用單株抗體 **Trastuzumab（Herceptin）** 進行標靶治療。
**(A) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`Amplification of ERBB2 (HER-2) gene` —— `ERBB2` 編碼表皮生長因子受體家族成員，基因擴增導致受體過度表現與預後較差，為乳癌最重要的原致癌基因擴增考點。
**(B)/(C)/(D)/(E)/(F) 錯誤**：1p 缺失與 `N-MYC` 擴增見於神經母細胞瘤；`EWS-FLI1` `t(11;22)` 見於 Ewing sarcoma；無家族史故非生殖系 `BRCA1` 突變；`BCL2` 轉位見於濾泡性淋巴瘤。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q18) Official Explanation｜PBD9 284, 287｜BP9 174】**：`18 A: Amplification and overexpression of the ERBB2 (HER2/neu) receptor tyrosine kinase gene occurs in up to 20-25% of invasive breast carcinomas and correlates with rapid progression, aggressive metastatic spread, and sensitivity to anti-HER2 antibody therapy (trastuzumab / Herceptin).`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）

questions.year: 📘 大R題庫 Ch.7 Q19｜大R題庫 Ch.7 第 19 題
questions.stem: 【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q19】A 2-year-old boy has an abdominal mass above the right kidney. The resected adrenal mass microscopically consists of sheets of small round blue cells. Karyotypic analysis of the tumor cells identifies numerous double minutes and homogeneously staining regions. Amplification of which of the following genes is most likely present in these tumor cells?
explanations: 📘 **【大R題庫 Ch.7 Q19｜基因擴增（Gene Amplification）：Double minutes 與 HSRs（PBD9 284–285 / BP9 175）】**：幼兒腎上腺小圓藍細胞腫瘤為**神經母細胞瘤（Neuroblastoma）**。當原致癌基因發生數十至數百倍的**基因擴增（Gene amplification）**時，在染色體核型上會呈現兩種特徵性結構：**雙微體（double minutes, dmin）**與**均質染色區（homogeneously staining regions, HSRs）**，其擴增的基因為 **`N-MYC`（`MYCN`）**。
**(F) 正確【本題應選正解】**：`N-MYC (transcription factor gene)` —— 神經母細胞瘤伴隨 `N-MYC` 基因擴增（表現出 double minutes 與 HSRs）是預後不良的最重要分子指標（與乳癌 `ERBB2` 擴增並列大R兩大基因擴增代表）。
**(A)~(E) 錯誤**：`BCL1 (Cyclin D1)`、`BCL2`、`IL2`、`K-RAS`、`Lyn` 皆非神經母細胞瘤出現 double minutes / HSRs 的擴增基因。

📖 **【Robbins Review 4th Ed. (Ch.7 Q19) Official Explanation｜PBD9 284–285｜BP9 175】**：`19 F: Childhood neuroblastoma arising in the adrenal medulla often shows gene amplification of the N-MYC (MYCN) proto-oncogene, which manifests karyotypically as extrachromosomal double minutes (dmin) or intrachromosomal homogeneously staining regions (HSRs) and strongly predicts poor prognosis.`（來源：[大三整合2 Notebook 大R題庫](https://gemini.google.com/notebook/01b3322a-9c0a-498f-91ce-4c29f24657f5)）
